svg.title: Example: Pre-mortem
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape pre-mortem board: the failure scenario, reasons it failed, top risks after dot voting, prevention and early warning signs, and next steps.
svg.text: Imagine the work has already failed, explain why, then act now to prevent the most likely causes.
Run a Project · Inspired by Gary Klein's Pre-mortem · Prospective Hindsight · Risks Before They Happen
READ IT ALOUD · SPEAK AS IF IT HAS ALREADY HAPPENED
and this has failed badly. What went wrong?
SILENT WRITING FIRST · ONE REASON PER STICKY
Everyone writes alone for 5 minutes, in the past tense: “We lost our key supplier”
Think wide: people, tech, customers, money, dependencies, decisions
Top risks added to the RAID Log
Prevention actions added to the backlog
Warning signs visible on the team board
Plan or scope changed where needed
Re-run before the next big milestone
“It's six months from now and this has failed. What happened?”
“Which of these are we quietly hoping won't happen?”
Run a Project · Stakeholders · Forecasts · Risks

g.text: customers cancel, Finance stops it, and the team is worn out
Spike it with Payments, including expired cards
Reminder email 2 days before each delivery
Over 2 hours a day adding items
Go / no-go on 6 June, with the data
Pressure to set a launch date
